goal: Develop a vibe coded app using AI Studio and store the files in GitHub

pipeline.name: Sub-Questions Decomposition
pipeline.description: Breaks a topic into theoretical, algorithmic, systems, security/privacy, and frontier questions with rationales and priority tags.

pipeline.name: Key Papers and Seminal Authors
pipeline.description: Curates landmark papers with venue, year, summaries, arXiv/DOI links, BibTeX export, and key researcher profiles.

pipeline.name: Summary of Findings and Trade-offs
pipeline.description: Synthesizes cross-paper consensus, core formulations, benchmarks, and a comparative methods and trade-offs matrix.

pipeline.name: Research Gaps and Hypotheses
pipeline.description: Detects unresolved bottlenecks, explains why current methods fail, and proposes testable hypotheses.

features: Interactive Flow Map (Topic -> Sub-questions -> Papers -> Findings -> Gaps)
